overall_reason: All seven header items ('Product' to 'Get started') point to '#', the 375 header keeps the desktop link row with no menu so the links run off the screen, and the stylesheet declares one hover rule and no pressed, focus-visible or disabled state for any control.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I fails on seven dead nav links (CMP-012), T-PHONE-NAV fails on a desktop nav row at 375 (CMP-011), T-STATE-MATRIX finds one declared hover and nothing else (CMP-002), and T-PRIMARY-COUNT finds three labels for one trial (CMP-121).

visitor_mode: Persuade: a SaaS landing page whose goal is a free-trial sign-up. No 00-contract.md; inferred from 'Start free trial' in the hero and 'Start your free trial' in the closing band.

findings.title: Every navigation item and action goes somewhere
findings.evidence: The components table records 7 dead links in the header: 'Product', 'Solutions', 'Pricing', 'Customers', 'Docs', 'Sign in' and 'Get started' all point to '#'; the first stop after the skip link is 'Product' with href '#'.
findings.before: Seven header items that go nowhere.
findings.after: Each item linked to its page or section, and items with no page removed; [DATA NEEDED: the pricing, docs and sign-in URLs].
findings.why: A visitor who clicks Pricing, Docs or Sign in stays where they are with no explanation.

findings.title: The phone gets the whole navigation
findings.evidence: phone_nav lists all seven header items in the 375 header and no menu button; fold-375.png shows 'Product', 'Solutions' and a cut-off 'Pricing' with the rest past the right edge, and the logo's dot sits on its own line above 'Lumina'. The overflow sweep reports the page 698px wide at 375.
findings.before: The desktop link row is kept at 375 and runs off the screen.
findings.after: Under about 60rem the links go behind a 'Menu' button (aria-expanded), leaving the logo, 'Start free trial' and the menu (CMP-154).
findings.why: Phone visitors cannot see or reach Customers, Docs, Sign in or the header's sign-up button.

findings.title: Every state a control can reach is designed
findings.evidence: declared_states reads 51 readable rules with 1 hover rule and 0 focus-visible, 0 focus, 0 active and 0 disabled rules. The header 'Get started' renders underlined inside its filled black pill (fold-1440.png), so the one hover style is a text underline borrowed from links.
findings.before: Buttons have a resting look and an underline on hover only.
findings.after: A focus-visible ring, a pressed state one step lighter or 1px lower, and a hover step of the button's own fill (CMP-267), on each variant.
findings.why: A press or a keyboard focus gives no designed feedback, and an underlined button reads as a link.

findings.title: The main action reads word for word the same in nav, hero, close and phone action bar
findings.where: header, hero and closing band, 1440, fold-1440.png and tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: The filled pill reads 'Get started' in the header and 'Start free trial →' in the hero; the closing band 'Ready to transform how your team builds?' uses a light pill 'Start your free trial →'.
findings.before: Three labels and two fills for one trial sign-up.
findings.after: 'Start free trial' on every sign-up button, in the same fill (inverted only on the dark band).
findings.why: Different labels make the visitor wonder whether 'Get started' is the trial or something else.

strengths: A skip link is the first focus stop.
The hero pairs one filled primary with an outlined secondary ('Watch demo'), and the closing band carries a single action.
not_investigated: The trial sign-up flow: every action links to '#', so there is no flow to capture; the async capture found no primary action.
Inline validation and error placement: no fields.
Focus visibility itself: the focus_ring sweep reported no hit; with no focus-visible rule the browser default is in use.
Keyboard operation of custom widgets: lens-a11y.

Capture prep blocked the host's '/js/detect-antipatterns-browser.js' script; the page is served under an 'antipattern-examples' path but its own text does not label it as an example, so it is judged as a landing page.
T-FIELD-READ, T-ERROR-PATH, T-OVERLAY-CHECK, T-TABLE-READ and T-FIRST-RUN: no field, no failure run, no overlay, no table and no onboarding.
